{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0

CD="/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp001"

wait_for_model() {
    local dir="$1"
    local name="$2"
    echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] Waiting for $name weights at $dir ..."
    while true; do
        count=$(ls "$dir"/*.safetensors 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
        idx_exists=$(ls "$dir"/model.safetensors.index.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
        if [ "$count" -gt 0 ] && [ "$idx_exists" -gt 0 ]; then
            expected=$(python -c "import json; d=json.load(open('$dir/model.safetensors.index.json')); print(len(set(d['weight_map'].values())))" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
            if [ "$count" -ge "$expected" ] && [ "$expected" -gt 0 ]; then
                temp_count=$(ls "$dir"/._____temp/*.safetensors 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
                if [ "$temp_count" -eq 0 ]; then
                    break
                fi
            fi
        fi
        sleep 30
    done
    echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $name download complete ($count/$expected safetensors files)"
}

# Llama on GPU 2
wait_for_model "/root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct" "Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct"
echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] Launching llama on GPU 2"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 python -u $CD/generate_vllm_batch.py --model llama-3.1-8b > /tmp/gen_llama.log 2>&1 &
LLAMA_PID=$!
echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] llama PID: $LLAMA_PID"

# Qwen2.5 on GPU 3
wait_for_model "/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct" "Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct"
echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] Launching qwen2.5 on GPU 3"
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 python -u $CD/generate_vllm_batch.py --model qwen2.5-7b > /tmp/gen_qwen25.log 2>&1 &
QWEN_PID=$!
echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] qwen2.5 PID: $QWEN_PID"

# Mistral - wait for a GPU to free up (qwen3-8b or gemma should finish first)
wait_for_model "/root/autodl-tmp/models/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3" "Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3"
echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] Waiting for any GPU to free up..."
while true; do
    for gpu in 0 1 2 3; do
        mem=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -i $gpu 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
        if [ "$mem" -lt 1000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] GPU $gpu free, launching mistral"
            CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$gpu python -u $CD/generate_vllm_batch.py --model mistral-7b-v0.3 > /tmp/gen_mistral.log 2>&1 &
            MISTRAL_PID=$!
            echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] mistral PID: $MISTRAL_PID"
            break 2
        fi
    done
    sleep 30
done

echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] All models launched. Waiting..."
wait
echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] === ALL DONE ==="
